title: Faggot
html_source:
A shrivelled bint:

Mrs. Riordan appeared in A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man. She was derived from an embittered governesses (Mrs. Conway) who joined the Joyce household when they moved to Bray (Ellmann p24-25).
